## Pipeline design generated

The pipeline design is written to `.wire/releases/01-data-foundation/design/pipeline_architecture.md`.

| Item | Result |
|------|--------|
| Pipeline tool | `custom` (Cloud Functions), still waiting on decision PD-1 |
| Source systems | 5: Shopify, Stripe, Klaviyo, Shipstation, GA4 (17 tables) |
| Connectors checked against the tool | 0 of 5 |
| Models planned | 16 staging, 20 warehouse |
| Data flow diagram | Included |
| Decisions needing input | 3 |

**Connectors.** No Fivetran tools were available in this session, so nothing was checked against a live tool. All 17 tables were checked against the source schema file (`ddl.sql`) instead. Before the build, someone needs to confirm two things: that connectors exist for Shopify, Stripe and Shipstation, and how Klaviyo and GA4 data gets into the `raw_` dataset.

**Decisions needing input**

| Code | Decision | Recommendation | Who decides |
|------|----------|----------------|-------------|
| PD-1 | Which tool loads the data in production | Use Cloud Functions, as the statement of work says, only if Acme's team will own the code. Otherwise keep Fivetran, because Acme is worried about upkeep (NFR-4). | Priya, Becky |
| PD-2 | How Klaviyo and GA4 data gets into the warehouse | Read it from the existing `raw_` dataset. Depends on PD-1. | Priya |
| PD-3 | How many days of GA4 data to reload, to catch events that arrive late | Reload the last 3 days on every run | Data team |

`status.md` records `pipeline_tool: custom` now, so later commands know which route to take. Change it if PD-1 goes the other way.

**Data gaps.** Six gaps are flagged in the document:
- There is no address table in the source data.
- No field links a Stripe payment to its invoice. This affects how refunds are taken off monthly recurring revenue.
- There is no agreed way to link GA4 visitors to Stripe customers. Before 2024, about 12% of records have no user ID.
- No single campaign ID is shared by Klaviyo and GA4.
- The list of cancellation reasons is proposed but not confirmed. This still blocks the build.
- It is not agreed which system wins when Shopify and Stripe disagree on a subscription's status.

**Other notes**
- Open question numbers follow the requirements document. The conceptual model numbers its open questions differently.
- Jira and the document store are not set up, so nothing was synced.
- I could not draw the diagram, because the diagram tool (`mmdc`) is not installed. Its structure was checked by hand.
- `status.md`, `execution_log.md` and `decisions.md` are updated.
